title: Catalog Simplification & Billing Transition Orchestration
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Goal: Execute a low-friction migration from the existing multi-SKU pricing catalog to a simplified tiered catalog while ensuring billing continuity, accurate customer invoicing, and minimal support load. This ticket coordinates cross-functional launch tasks: mapping old SKUs to new tiers, implementing limits & quotas, drafting release notes, customer-facing comms, billing system migration, and sales enablement.

Scope:
- Produce SKU->Tier mapping and apply in billing pipeline.
- Finalize limits and quota adjustments per tier and publish in Console.
- Author customer-facing migration emails, in-console banners, and release notes.
- Deliver sales enablement materials and host training sessions.

Out of scope:
- Major product repricing (feature value-based price changes).
- Custom enterprise contract negotiations (handled case-by-case by AMs).

Risks & mitigations:
- Billing mismatches: run a dry-run in staging for top-20 customers, and keep manual rollback window open for 48 hours.
- Rate-limit regressions after quota changes: perf test with Dedicated load harness (ENG-4980).
- Confusion across Sales/Support: synchronous enablement sessions + FAQ + playbook.

Sales enablement package completed: battlecards, conversion calculator, and training recorded

Phase 1 - Soft Launch (2026-03-19): migrate non-enterprise accounts behind a feature flag; monitor billing reconciliation for 24h
Phase 2 - Open Launch (2026-03-24): enable migration for all self-serve accounts; send targeted emails to impacted customers
Phase 3 - Enterprise Outreach (2026-03-24 to 2026-04-01): account execs engage on bespoke contract customers; manual reconciliations as needed
Phase 4 - Stabilize (2026-04-02 to 2026-04-09): monitor metrics, run post-mortem, finalize evergreen docs
